best_match.fbbt_definition: Adult unilateral odorant receptor neuron that expresses Gr21a and Gr63a (Couto et al., 2005; Kwon et al., 2007; Kaur et al., 2019; Benton et al., 2025). It responds to CO2 levels (Suh et al., 2004; Kwon et al., 2007). Its dendrite transduces signals from antennal basiconic sensillum ab1 and sends output to antennal glomerulus V (Benton et al., 2025). It develops from an Nbb precursor (Benton et al., 2025). There are around 30-40 of these cells on each side (Grabe et al., 2016; Benton et al., 2025).

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00067064 'adult olfactory receptor neuron Gr21a/63a', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
